================================================================================
Create a procedure with parameters
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE shop.p (IN a INT, OUT b VARCHAR(10), INOUT c DECIMAL(5, 2))
BEGIN
  SET b = 'x';
  SET c = c + a;
END;

================================================================================
Create a procedure with characteristics
================================================================================

CREATE DEFINER = CURRENT_USER PROCEDURE p ()
  COMMENT 'demo'
  LANGUAGE SQL
  NOT DETERMINISTIC
  READS SQL DATA
  SQL SECURITY DEFINER
BEGIN
END;

---

  (create_procedure_statement
    (definer
      (account))

      (string))

    (characteristic)

    (characteristic)
    (block)))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with declarations
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p ()
BEGIN
  DECLARE a, b INT DEFAULT 0;
  DECLARE s VARCHAR(20);
  DECLARE not_found CONDITION FOR SQLSTATE '02000';
  DECLARE dup CONDITION FOR 1062;
  SELECT a, b, s;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))

        (identifier)

================================================================================
Create a procedure with a cursor
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p ()
BEGIN
  DECLARE done INT DEFAULT FALSE;
  DECLARE v INT;
  DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM t;
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR NOT FOUND SET done = TRUE;
  OPEN cur;
  read_loop: LOOP
    FETCH cur INTO v;
    IF done THEN
      LEAVE read_loop;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO u VALUES (v);
  END LOOP read_loop;
  CLOSE cur;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (block
      (declare_variable
        (identifier)
        (data_type
          (type_name))
        (boolean))
      (declare_variable
        (identifier)
        (data_type
          (type_name)))
      (declare_cursor
        (identifier)
        (select_statement
          (select
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (from_clause
              (table_reference
                (identifier))))))
      (declare_handler
        (set_statement
          (variable_assignment
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (boolean))))
      (open_statement
        (identifier))
      (loop_statement
        (identifier)
        (fetch_statement
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (if_statement
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (leave_statement
            (identifier)))
        (insert_statement
          (object_reference
            (identifier))
          (values_clause
            (value_list
              (column_reference
                (identifier)))))
        (identifier))
      (close_statement
        (identifier)))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with handlers
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p ()
BEGIN
  DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION, SQLWARNING
  BEGIN
    ROLLBACK;
    RESIGNAL;
  END;
  DECLARE CONTINUE HANDLER FOR 1051, SQLSTATE VALUE '42S02' SET @err = 1;
  START TRANSACTION;
  COMMIT;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (block
      (declare_handler
        (block
          (rollback_statement)
          (resignal_statement)))
      (declare_handler
        (number)
        (string)
        (set_statement
          (variable_assignment
            (user_variable)
            (number))))
      (start_transaction_statement)
      (commit_statement))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with if
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p (n INT)
BEGIN
  IF n > 0 THEN
    SELECT 'positive';
  ELSEIF n < 0 THEN
    SELECT 'negative';
  ELSE
    SELECT 'zero';
  END IF;
END;

---

  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference

              (identifier))
            (number))

              (string))))

          (select_statement
            (select
              (string))))))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with a case statement
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p (n INT)
BEGIN
  CASE n
    WHEN 1 THEN SELECT 'one';
    WHEN 2 THEN SELECT 'two';
    ELSE BEGIN END;
  END CASE;
  CASE
    WHEN n > 10 THEN SET @big = 1;
  END CASE;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (routine_parameter

      (data_type
        (type_name)))

        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (when_clause
          (number)
          (select_statement
            (select
              (string))))
        (when_clause
          (number)
          (select_statement
            (select
              (string))))
        (else_clause
          (block)))
      (case_statement
        (when_clause
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (number))
          (set_statement
            (variable_assignment
              (user_variable)
              (number))))))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with while and repeat
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p ()
BEGIN
  DECLARE i INT DEFAULT 0;
  w: WHILE i < 10 DO
    SET i = i + 1;
    IF i = 5 THEN
      ITERATE w;
    END IF;
  END WHILE w;
  REPEAT
    SET i = i - 1;
  UNTIL i <= 0
  END REPEAT;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (block
      (declare_variable
        (identifier)
        (data_type
          (type_name))
        (number))
      (while_statement
        (identifier)
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (number))
        (set_statement
          (variable_assignment
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (binary_expression
              (column_reference
                (identifier))
              (number))))
        (if_statement
          (binary_expression
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (number))
          (iterate_statement
            (identifier)))
        (identifier))
      (repeat_statement
        (set_statement
          (variable_assignment
            (column_reference
              (identifier))
            (binary_expression
              (column_reference
                (identifier))
              (number))))
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (number))))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with a labeled block
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p ()
outer_block: BEGIN
  inner_block: BEGIN
    LEAVE outer_block;
  END inner_block;
END outer_block;

      (identifier))))

================================================================================
Create a procedure with signal
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p (x INT)
BEGIN
  IF x < 0 THEN
    SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'negative', MYSQL_ERRNO = 1644;
  END IF;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_procedure_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (routine_parameter
      (identifier)
      (data_type
        (type_name)))
    (block
      (if_statement
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (number))
        (signal_statement
          (string)
          (identifier)
          (string)
          (identifier)
          (number))))))

================================================================================
Create a function with a body
================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION hello (s CHAR(20)) RETURNS CHAR(50) CHARSET utf8mb4
DETERMINISTIC NO SQL
BEGIN
  DECLARE r CHAR(50);
  SET r = CONCAT('Hello, ', s, '!');
  RETURN r;
END;

---

  (create_function_statement
    (object_reference

================================================================================
Create a trigger with a body
================================================================================

CREATE DEFINER = 'root'@'%' TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg AFTER UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW FOLLOWS other
BEGIN
  IF NEW.a <> OLD.a THEN
    INSERT INTO audit (a, b) VALUES (OLD.a, NEW.a);
  END IF;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_trigger_statement
    (definer
      (account
        (string)
        (string)))
    (object_reference
      (identifier))

      (identifier))
    (identifier)
    (block
      (if_statement
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))
        (insert_statement
          (object_reference
            (identifier))
          (column_list
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (values_clause
            (value_list
              (column_reference
                (identifier)
                (identifier))
              (column_reference

                (identifier)))))))))
